scope: Published native oak wood and actual wind uniforms/shader. A floating-point software-WebGL diagnostic reads bark coordinates for 256 native vertices at times 0 and 3 seconds. The source assignment is overlaid onto the native compiled hook; geometry, textures and wind are unchanged. GPU deformed-position hashes must match, and a controlled zero-wind check must be pixel-identical. Native post/MSAA images isolate the original wood at the same time, with only that assignment varied. Not a hardware timing or art-quality score.
